run_situation_checks: run situation checks on a list of game situations with a given agent and kwargs
run_policy_situation_checks: run policy situation checks on game situations using a search or supervised agent
run_orders_situation_checks: run orders situation checks to verify agent orders against expected test conditions
run_situation_check_from_cfg: run situation checks from a SituationCheckTask config with optional seed and single game
order_prob: compute the total probability of expected orders across all powers in a policy distribution
